title: C: Logger Library
description: Build a simple logging library with log levels (INFO, WARN, ERROR) and formatted output.

steps.title: Log Levels and Formatting
steps.description: Define log levels as an enum: INFO, WARN, ERROR. Implement `void log_msg(int level, char *msg)` that prints `[LEVEL]: msg`. Implement a macro `LOG_ERROR(msg)` that calls log_msg with ERROR level. Test all three levels.
hints: Use `typedef enum { INFO, WARN, ERROR } LogLevel;`.

verification.failureMessage: Print messages at all three log levels
